criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.diff.diff_libraries(before, after, *, ignore_fields=()). Compare real entries by exact citation key, case-normalized entry/field names and actual values independent of formatting/field order. Return stable ordered added/removed/changed records, distinguish missing fields from None, support explicit ignored fields, and separately report string-macro/comment/failed-block changes preserving multiplicity. Reports must own copied mutable values and never mutate or merge input Libraries; avoid repr-based unstable facts.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
